A '''metalsmith''' or '''blacksmith''' was a being trained in working and shaping different types of [[Ore/Legends|ores]] and metals. A number of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] were trained metalsmiths, able to work the rare and durable ore [[Beskar/Legends|beskar iron]], only found on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. [[Warb Null|Shas Dovos]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] was a blacksmith, as was the [[Mandalorian Protectors (Spar)|Mandalorian Protector]] [[Medrit Vasur]].
